search_text: published ZDI-09-023 ZDI-CAN-462 Apple OS X ATSServer Compact Font Format Parsing Memory Corruption Vulnerability 2009-05-13 CVE-2009-0154 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-0154 ['Apple'] ['OS X'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple OS X. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw appears to exist in the ATSServer font server upon parsing of malicious Compact Font Format files. A boundary condition exists in the parsing of internal dictionaries that can lead to a memory corruption allowing the execution of arbitrary code. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://support.apple.com/kb/HT3549 ['2009-03-19 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2009-05-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Charlie Miller, Independent Security Evaluators https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-09-023/
title: Apple OS X ATSServer Compact Font Format Parsing Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple OS X. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw appears to exist in the ATSServer font server upon parsing of malicious Compact Font Format files. A boundary condition exists in the parsing of internal dictionaries that can lead to a memory corruption allowing the execution of arbitrary code.
